_about: Population tiers and how residents behave. 'needs' are units of a good eaten per resident per minute. A need named in 'capacityWithout' only limits how full the house gets. Tax is coins per resident per minute. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored by the game.
_growthIntervalSeconds: A house with all needs met gains one resident this often, up to its capacity.
_declineIntervalSeconds: A house with an unmet need loses one resident this often.
_minResidents: Residents never drop below this once a house has been lived in. Houses never downgrade.

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan._capacityWithout: A need listed here is not needed to live in the house, only to fill it: without it the house holds this many at most. Wine comes only from the second island, so before that island is open it is not missed at all.
